input.entry_source: M118 or M115 paper entry router JSON
input.exit_source: optional M121 paper exit router JSON
input.mark_source: optional M119 paper position mark time-series JSON

reconciliation_rules.entry_positions: Use paper_positions long/short quantities and average prices as the starting paper position state.
reconciliation_rules.exit_fills: Subtract M121 realized_pnl_ledger closed_quantity by action: SELL reduces long quantity; BUY_TO_COVER reduces short quantity.
reconciliation_rules.realized_pnl: Sum M121 realized_pnl rows by symbol.
reconciliation_rules.unrealized_pnl: When latest marks are supplied, calculate remaining open long/short PnL from latest mark and entry average price.
reconciliation_rules.status: open when any open long or short quantity remains; closed when entry quantity existed but no open quantity remains.

safety.description: M122 reconciles simulated entries, simulated exits, and latest paper marks into a paper portfolio state only. It does not call broker order APIs, submit orders, transmit orders, or mutate a real portfolio.
